summary.text: AUTOSKADE ELVERUM AS is a private limited company registered in Elverum, founded 2000-11-23. AUTOSKADE ELVERUM AS runs a body repair workshop, paints vehicles and sells car-related products. The statutory purpose also includes car rental and holding interests in other companies. Its main industry code is 95.310: repair and maintenance of motor vehicles. The register shows 16 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 29 178 559 NOK and the annual result was 681 197 NOK; operating income was down from 35 687 679 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 1 909 423 NOK in 2024 to 681 197 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 2 997 996 NOK in 2024 to 3 004 192 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is autoskade.no, which links to its Facebook, Instagram profiles. Its website links to a careers page or job board. The registered employee count went from 17 on 2026-07-16 to 16 on 2026-09-15. Recent changes in the register: email set to ari@autoskade.no on 2026-05-15.
